value.name: Lucia accuses Daniel of dismissing Rosa
value.description: Lucia tells Daniel he repeated Rosa's words in a way that made her opinion seem unimportant, comparing it to how he used to evade their mother as children.
evidence: "You said *Rosa says.* You said it the way you used to say *Mami says* when we were children and you didn't want to do something she had asked you to do. You said it like she was — like her saying didn't count."

value.name: Daniel denies Lucia's accusation
value.description: Daniel rejects Lucia's claim that he dismissed Rosa's authority.

value.name: Lucia insists Daniel is lying
value.description: Lucia flatly contradicts Daniel and refuses to back down.

value.name: siblings argue in the hallway
value.description: Daniel and Lucia face each other in the mother's front hall, revealing a long-standing sibling conflict that Asha recognizes as familiar and habitual.
evidence: "They were facing each other now, brother and sister, in the front hall of the house their mother had lived in for fifty-one years"
"she had the brief disorienting sense that she had ceased to be in the room"
"they had probably been doing in this hallway since they were eight and twelve."

value.name: Asha reasserts control over the exchange
value.description: Asha interrupts the siblings, identifies them formally, and instructs them to answer her question separately without interrupting each other.
evidence: "I am going to ask the two of you a question, and I am going to ask you to answer it separately, and not to interrupt each other. Is that all right."

value.name: siblings agree to answer separately
value.description: Daniel and Lucia each consent to Asha's instruction to answer her question separately.

value.name: Asha questions Daniel about removed documents
value.description: Asha asks Daniel whether he took any documents or papers from the house or sewing-room desk after his mother's death without telling anyone.
evidence: "Mr. Serrano. Did you, at any point between your mother's death and this morning, remove any item — any document, any folder, any piece of paper — from this house, from the sewing-room desk, or from any other location, without telling me or Rosa or your sister."
value.time_hint: between your mother's death and this morning

value.name: Daniel is caught off guard by the accusation
value.description: Daniel reacts silently and realizes the question is being asked bluntly in front of the others, showing he did not expect this confrontation.
evidence: "He had not expected the question to be put quite that way, that bluntly, in the front hall, with his sister and his mother's housekeeper and his attorney's paralegal all standing within"
